name: @engenty/document-sources
description: Pluggable URL / feed / index adapters and helpers for scheduled document ingestion (consumers: knowledge-base, etc.)

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/adapters/public.ts src/react/document-source-schedule-fields.tsx src/registry-export.ts src/schedule-export.ts --format esm --dts --clean --external react --external react-dom --external @engenty/ui-core
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts src/adapters/public.ts src/react/document-source-schedule-fields.tsx src/registry-export.ts src/schedule-export.ts --format esm --dts --watch --external react --external react-dom --external @engenty/ui-core
